chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Hammad, from Rib'i, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: May a man recite the adhan while he is sitting? He said: Yes; but he should not recite the iqamah except while he is standing.

key_terms.يُؤَذِّنُ: to recite the adhan, the call to prayer
key_terms.يُقِيمُ: to recite the iqamah, the call marking the start of salat

ai.seo_question: Can a person recite the adhan while sitting, and must the iqamah be done standing?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the posture for adhan and iqamah. It indicates that giving the adhan while seated is permissible, whereas the iqamah should only be performed while standing.
